messages.text: Your refund proposal is for **BRL 93.50**. Please confirm the exact proposal using the button on the proposal card; replying “yes” here won’t confirm it. After you confirm, a staff member will review it.

I never used the bag; I only took it out of the box. I don’t accept this decision. Could I speak to a person?
